<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>LISTO recorte 65,229 1407x557 -&gt; 1000x396 · fondo fuera 303879 · borde 6501</title></head>
<body style="background:#fff">
<pre id="out" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all">data:image/png;base64,</pre>
<img id="src" src="logo_sin_fondo.png" style="display:none">
<script>
const img = document.getElementById('src');
img.onload = () => {
  const W = img.naturalWidth, H = img.naturalHeight;
  const c0 = document.createElement('canvas');
  c0.width = W; c0.height = H;
  const g0 = c0.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
  g0.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
  const src = g0.getImageData(0, 0, W, H);
  const s = src.data;

  // saturacion como proxy: el logo es azul/cian saturado, el fondo es gris con ruido
  const sat = (i) => {
    const r = s[i], g = s[i + 1], b = s[i + 2];
    return Math.max(r, g, b) - Math.min(r, g, b);
  };

  // 1) recuadro del contenido realmente coloreado
  let x0 = W, y0 = H, x1 = 0, y1 = 0;
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
      if (sat((y * W + x) * 4) > 45) {
        if (x < x0) x0 = x; if (x > x1) x1 = x;
        if (y < y0) y0 = y; if (y > y1) y1 = y;
      }
    }
  }
  const pad = 8;
  x0 = Math.max(0, x0 - pad); y0 = Math.max(0, y0 - pad);
  x1 = Math.min(W - 1, x1 + pad); y1 = Math.min(H - 1, y1 + pad);
  const cw = x1 - x0 + 1, ch = y1 - y0 + 1;

  // 2) recorte + escalado
  const TARGET_W = 1000;
  const scale = TARGET_W / cw;
  const out = document.createElement('canvas');
  out.width = Math.round(cw * scale);
  out.height = Math.round(ch * scale);
  const g1 = out.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
  g1.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
  g1.drawImage(img, x0, y0, cw, ch, 0, 0, out.width, out.height);

  // 3) matte por saturacion: gris fuera, color dentro, bordes con alfa parcial
  const od = g1.getImageData(0, 0, out.width, out.height);
  const p = od.data;
  let fuera = 0, borde = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i += 4) {
    const r = p[i], g = p[i + 1], b = p[i + 2];
    const st = Math.max(r, g, b) - Math.min(r, g, b);
    if (st < 22) { p[i + 3] = 0; fuera++; }
    else if (st < 62) { p[i + 3] = Math.round(((st - 22) / 40) * 255); borde++; }
    else { p[i + 3] = 255; }
  }
  g1.putImageData(od, 0, 0);

  document.getElementById('out').textContent = out.toDataURL('image/png');
  document.title = 'LISTO recorte ' + x0 + ',' + y0 + ' ' + cw + 'x' + ch +
                   ' -> ' + out.width + 'x' + out.height +
                   ' · fondo fuera ' + fuera + ' · borde ' + borde;
};
</script>

</body></html>
